title: キャラシート・背景・小物（ギター等）の資料を参照素材として用意し、Seedance 2.0で一貫した短編アニメを生成する
content:
キャラシート・背景・小物（ギター等）の資料を参照素材として用意し、Seedance 2.0で一貫した短編アニメを生成する  
各カットを1本ずつ生成→確認→修正を繰り返してから、最後にタイムラインで組み立てて約45秒のMV導入アニメに仕上げる
tips:

en.content:
Prepare reference materials such as character sheets, backgrounds, and props (e.g., guitar) to use as reference material, and generate a consistent short animation with Seedance 2.0.  
Generate each cut one by one → review → make corrections, and then finally assemble them on the timeline to create an approximately 45-second MV introduction animation.

es.content:
---
Prepare reference materials such as character sheets, backgrounds, and props (like guitars) to use as reference material, and generate a consistent short animation with Seedance 2.0.  
Generate each cut one by one → review → make corrections repeatedly, then finally assemble them on the timeline to create an approximately 45-second MV intro animation.
---

fr.content:
Préparez des feuilles de personnage, des arrière-plans et des accessoires (comme une guitare) en tant que matériel de référence, et générez un court métrage d'animation cohérent avec Seedance 2.0.  
Générez chaque plan un par un → vérifiez → corrigez, puis assemblez-les sur une timeline pour créer une introduction d'environ 45 secondes pour un clip musical.

ko.content:
---
캐릭터 시트, 배경, 소품(기타 등)의 자료를 참조 자료로 준비하고, Seedance 2.0으로 일관된 단편 애니메이션을 생성한다  
각 컷을 하나씩 생성→확인→수정을 반복한 후, 마지막에 타임라인에서 조립하여 약 45초의 MV 도입 애니메이션으로 완성한다
---

pt.content:
Prepare reference materials such as character sheets, backgrounds, and props (like guitars) to use as reference material, and generate a consistent short animation with Seedance 2.0  
Gerar cada cena uma por uma → verificar → corrigir repetidamente, e depois montar na linha do tempo para finalizar em uma animação de introdução de MV de aproximadamente 45 segundos

zh.content:
---
准备角色表、背景、小物件（如吉他等）的参考资料，使用Seedance 2.0生成一致的短篇动画  
每个镜头逐一生成→确认→修正，然后在时间线上组装，最终制作成约45秒的MV引入动画
---
